description: Particle-1 is Particle AI’s coding and data-engineering model, post-trained on DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. It accepts text and images, supports tool calling, and offers a shared 1,048,576-token context window with up to 131,072 output tokens, including reasoning. Reasoning defaults to high and can be turned off. JSON formatting is supported; strict JSON-schema enforcement is not guaranteed.
name: Particle-1
